name: Cedric
source:
He's Daisy's uncle. Usually bought a lot of presents and very doted on her. Had a gentle and good looking outward.
[spoiler]He's actually in love with David and plotting to separate him from Joshua, with the help of Mathias. He also killed David's father, and gave Mathias a "slave" portion to use on Joshua.[/spoiler]
